verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a self-hosted deployment that runs entirely on your own infrastructure (pip, Docker Compose, or Kubernetes) with your own LLM keys or a local model. That lets a user decide where run data and artifacts physically live, but the managed cloud documents no region or residency selection. The residential proxy country targeting is about browsing egress, not data storage, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: region selection or data-residency guarantees for Skyvern Cloud, documentation of where cloud artifacts are stored, independent corroboration.
